verdict.rationale: Evidence covers SDKs, error handling, retries, MCP server, and rate-limit tiers, but there is no mention of API versioning scheme or a documented deprecation policy anywhere in the pack. A community comment even notes model lineup regressed without clear communication, but that doesn't establish a documented policy either way — it's simply absent evidence. Missing for 10: any statement of API version numbers/headers, a deprecation/sunset policy, migration guides, or changelog commitments.
